response.explanation: The walk (collect_jsonl_files) includes every .jsonl, and JsonlTree has no skip_source. A journal.jsonl gets session_id None from peek_session_id, so is_session_fresh is false and it counts as pending. Zero-byte and timestamp-less files likewise get last_ts None, so they are never gated Empty. They are still read and counted pending, and there is no At/Empty/Opaque verdict.
response.intent_quote:
Workflow journal.jsonl control files leave the walk entirely
  (JsonlTree::skip_source): never a session, never read, never pending.
